subsystem.responsibility: Thread-safe 16-bit stream reads guarded by a stream critical section, and MSVC exception-string objects identified by the exception vftable (??_7exception@@6B@) with conditional deep-copy and owned-buffer destruction.

function_roles.role: Thread-safe 16-bit stream read wrapper: acquire stream critical section, delegate read to sub_59BE0C, release section, return the read value.
Exception string copy constructor: install exception vftable, measure source string, allocate length+1 buffer, copy string data when allocation succeeded, mark ownership flag set.

Exception string copy constructor with copy-mode flag: install exception vftable, copy source ownership flag; deep-copy the source string when the flag is non-zero, else share the source string pointer without allocation.

Exception string destructor: restore exception vftable, free the owned string buffer at +4 via the free wrapper when the ownership flag at +8 is non-zero, skip the free when the flag is zero (shared/borrowed string).

classes.name: MSVCExceptionString

Copy construction allocates a length+1 heap copy when the source flag is non-zero, or shares the source pointer when zero; destruction frees the owned buffer only when the flag is non-zero.

compatibility_contracts.name: LockedStreamRead16
compatibility_contracts.description: A 16-bit stream read is performed only while holding the stream critical section: acquire the section, delegate the read to the underlying stream reader, release the section, then return the read value. A replacement executable must preserve the acquire/read/release ordering and must not read the stream without holding the section.

compatibility_contracts.name: ExceptionStringOwnership
compatibility_contracts.description: Exception string objects expose vftable at +0, string buffer pointer at +4, and an ownership flag at +8. Non-zero flag: copy construction allocates length+1 bytes via the new wrapper and copies the source string, and destruction frees the buffer via the free wrapper. Zero flag: the source string pointer is shared without allocation and the destructor skips the free. A replacement must preserve the ownership decision and the vftable identity.
